steps.zh: 从 PyPI 安装这个库

steps.en: Fetch a transcript by video ID with a language priority list
steps.zh: 用视频 ID 加语言优先级列表取转写

steps.en: Calls the web client's undocumented transcript endpoint, preferring manual tracks
steps.zh: 调用网页端未公开的转写端点，默认优先人工字幕轨

component.zh: HTTP 客户端（无浏览器、无 key）

steps.en: Switch to a generated track, or have YouTube translate it
steps.zh: 换自动生成轨，或让 YouTube 翻译

steps.en: Hand back timestamped snippets you can format to SRT/WebVTT/JSON/text
steps.zh: 返回带时间戳片段，可格式化为 SRT/WebVTT/JSON/文本

value.en: Timestamped spoken text for any video ID, in a few key-free lines
value.zh: 任意视频 ID 的带时间戳口述文本，几行免 key 代码到手

sources: README.md @ master (retrieved 2026-09-28): 'pip install youtube-transcript-api' (Install); 'YouTubeTranscriptApi().fetch(video_id, languages=[\'de\', \'en\'])' (Retrieve different languages); 'By default this module always chooses manually created transcripts over automatically created ones' + 'transcript_list.find_generated_transcript' (List available transcripts); 'transcript.translate(\'de\')' (Translate transcript); formatters JSON/SRT/WebVTT/Text/PrettyPrint (Using Formatters)
